63759-the-brain-sinner.title: The Brain Sinner
63759-the-brain-sinner.creator: Unknown
63759-the-brain-sinner.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The alien moved, finally, beginning his preparations. In the center of the cabin an image flickered, swarming flecks of light and shadow that filled out a three-dimensional form, complete and detailed. The alien sat back and studied it through hooded yellow eyes--carefully, oh so carefully, for there must be no mistake, not here, not now. The scouts had come and gone, bringing back the data and specimens of the man-things necessary for a satisfactory disguise.

arxiv-1511-03448.title: On The Continuous Periodic Weak Solutions Of Boussinesq Equations
arxiv-1511-03448.creator: Tao Tao, Liqun Zhang
arxiv-1511-03448.description: Abstract . The Boussingesq equations was introduced in understanding the coupling nature of the thermodynamics and the fluid dynamics. We show the existence of continuous periodic weak solutions of the Boussinesq equations which satisfies the prescribed kinetic energy or some other prescribed property. Our results represent the conversions between internal energy and mechanical energy.

arxiv-2111-13181.title: Embeddings and Integrable Charges for Extended Corner Symmetry
arxiv-2111-13181.creator: Luca Ciambelli, Robert G. Leigh, Pin-Chun Pai
arxiv-2111-13181.description: Abstract We revisit the problem of extending the phase space of diffeomorphism-invariant theories to account for embeddings associated with the boundary of sub-regions. We do so by emphasizing the importance of a careful treatment of embeddings in all aspects of the covariant phase space formalism.

arxiv-2209-01630.title: A Recursive approach to the matrix moment problem
arxiv-2209-01630.creator: R.E. Curto, A. Ech-charyfy, K. Idrissi, E.H. Zerouali
arxiv-2209-01630.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the truncated matrix moment problem in one variable through recursive matrix extensions. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for a recursive matrix extension of finite data to be a matrix moment sequence in the classical cases of Hamburger, Stieltjes, and Hausdorff moment problems.

arxiv-2210-00200.title: Semiparametric Efficient Fusion of Individual Data and Summary Statistics
arxiv-2210-00200.creator: Wenjie Hu, Ruoyu Wang, Wei Li, Wang Miao
arxiv-2210-00200.description: Abstract Suppose we have individual data from an internal study and various summary statistics from relevant external studies. External summary statistics have the potential to improve statistical inference for the internal population; however, it may lead to efficiency loss or bias if not used properly.

arxiv-2302-13572.title: Recovering Cosmic Microwave Background Polarization Signals with Machine Learning
arxiv-2302-13572.creator: Ye-Peng Yan, Guo-Jian Wang, Si-Yu Li, Jun-Qing Xia
arxiv-2302-13572.description: Abstract Primordial B-mode detection is one of the main goals of current and future cosmic microwave background (CMB) experiments. However, the weak B-mode signal is overshadowed by several Galactic polarized emissions, such as thermal dust emission and synchrotron radiation. Subtracting foreground components from CMB observations is one of the key challenges in searching for the primordial B-mode signal.

arxiv-2308-09289.title: Preference-conditioned Pixel-based AI Agent For Game Testing PubID: pubid: 000-0-0000-0000-0/00/ 00.00 00.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2308-09289.creator: Sherif Abdelfattah §, Adrian Brown, Pushi Zhang
arxiv-2308-09289.description: Abstract The game industry is challenged to cope with increasing growth in demand and game complexity while maintaining acceptable quality standards for released games. Classic approaches solely depending on human efforts for quality assurance and game testing do not scale effectively in terms of time and cost.

arxiv-2312-05217.title: First-order, continuous, and multicritical Bose-Einstein condensation in Bose mixtures
arxiv-2312-05217.creator: Pawel Jakubczyk, Krzysztof Myśliwy, Marek Napiórkowski
arxiv-2312-05217.description: Abstract We address the possibility of realizing Bose-Einstein condensation as a first-order phase transition by admixture of particles of different species. To this aim we perform a comprehensive analysis of phase diagrams of two-component mixtures of bosons at finite temperatures. As a prototype model, we analyze a binary mixture of Bose particles interacting via an infinite-range (Kac-scaled) two-body potential.

arxiv-2503-09468.title: Beyond 2-approximation for k k -Center in Graphs
arxiv-2503-09468.creator: Ce Jin, Yael Kirkpatrick, Virginia Vassilevska Williams, Nicole Wein
arxiv-2503-09468.description: Abstract We consider the classical k k -Center problem in undirected graphs. The problem is known to have a polynomial-time 2-approximation. There are even ( 2 + ε ) (2+\varepsilon) -approximation algorithms for every ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 running in near-linear time.

arxiv-2507-14040.title: Markov matrix perturbations to optimize dynamical and entropy functionals
arxiv-2507-14040.creator: Manuel Santos Gutiérrez, Niccolò Zagli, Giulia Carigi
arxiv-2507-14040.description: Abstract An important problem in applied dynamical systems is to compute the external forcing that provokes the largest response of a desired observable quantity. For this, we investigate the perturbation theory of Markov matrices in connection with linear response theory in statistical physics.

pmc-11436731.creator: Silvester Sabathiel, Hèlios Sanchis-Alepuz, Andrew S. Wilson, Jacob Reynvaan, Monika Stipsitz

We introduce a neural-network-based approach to overcome these challenges.

The Action for Health in Diabetes (Look AHEAD) randomized controlled trial compared an intensive lifestyle intervention (ILI) designed to induce and maintain a 7% weight loss through caloric restriction and increased physical activity with a control condition of diabetes support and education (DSE) in 5,145 individuals aged 45-76 years with type 2 diabetes and overweight/obesity over

pmc-11738523.title: Lipid Profile and Cardiovascular Risk Monitoring in Patients on Clozapine – an Audit at a Community Mental Health Resource Centre in Scotland
pmc-11738523.creator: Aamir Shahzad
pmc-11738523.description: AimsIndividuals with severe mental illnesses are at an increased risk of morbidity and mortality from cardiovascular diseases compared with the general population. Dyslipidaemia is a well-established contributor to CVD risk, alongside factors such as obesity, hypertension, smoking, diabetes, and a sedentary lifestyle. Many patients with severe mental illnesses often exhibit a combination of these risk factors.

pmc-12678329.title: Imbalance of T cell subsets: a core event that mediates the progression of T2DM and its complications
pmc-12678329.creator: Xiang Xie, Fan Li, Qian Wu, Chunlan Zeng, Xi Chen, Wenwen Wang, Chunxiang Zhang, Huan Chen
pmc-12678329.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus poses a substantial global health burden, increasing evidence highlights the critical role of T cells in promoting T2DM progression. This review provides an overview of the mechanisms by which specific T cell subsets drive T2DM pathogenesis and its complications, while also highlighting emerging immunotherapeutic strategies.

pmc-12923193.title: Transdiagnostic Network Mapping of Psychopathology in Daily Life: Rationale and Research Protocol
pmc-12923193.creator: Guðrún R. Guðmundsdóttir, Anne Roefs, Alberto Jover Martínez, Anita Jansen, Eiko I. Fried, Esmée Groot, Lotte H. J. M. Lemmens
pmc-12923193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe burden of mental health problems and the need for more effective interventions is well established. One path towards treatment improvement involves more effective (evidence-based) tailoring, which requires a deeper understanding of differences in individual profiles of psychopathology.

pmc-13100582.title: KLF7 enhances the inflammatory response in LPS-induced alveolar epithelial cells via activating the LIMK1/SRPK1 pathway
pmc-13100582.creator: Bing Huang, Yanchao Liang, Fangwei Chen, Juan Zhou, Cancan Xie
pmc-13100582.description: IntroductionKrüppel-like factor 7 (KLF7) exhibits pro-inflammatory properties in numerous diseases, but its precise function in acute lung injury (ALI) remains ambiguous. This study aimed to elucidate the molecular mechanism of KLF7 in type II alveolar epithelial cells under ALI conditions.Material and methodsCell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assay and flow cytometry were employed to assess cell viability and apoptosis.

pmc-13335009.creator: Yusuf Ahmed, Abdulla Almubarak, Manar Ali, Jaafar Alsadeq Laith, Lujayn Juma, Walaa Yusuf, Zahraa Salman, Hana Asser, Mohamed Gabr, Ahmed Emara
pmc-13335009.description: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) has become an established treatment option for symptomatic severe aortic stenosis, particularly in older patients. In this meta-analysis, we compare the latest generations of self-expandable valves, Navitor (Abbott Structural Heart, Santa Clara, CA, USA), with balloon-expandable valves, Sapien (Edwards Lifesciences, Irvine, CA, USA), in TAVI.

pmc-13470353.title: Supervised satellite classification and field validation document endangered Acropora collapse, and identify surviving colonies in Belize
pmc-13470353.creator: Lisa Greer, Raja Das, Harris Foad, Karl Wirth
pmc-13470353.description: Acropora cervicornis and Acropora palmata have long provided structural complexity to Caribbean reefs, yet they have declined by over 90% in recent decades. Identifying places where wild populations of at-risk corals can survive remains essential for conservation. Coral Gardens, Belize, has historically been a refugium for endangered Acropora spp., but mass mortality transpired in 2023.

pmc-13475079.title: Economic burden of typhoid among hospitalised children in Kenya
pmc-13475079.creator: Prashant Mandaliya, Stacey Orangi, Isaac Waluke, Franklin Okech, Felix Masiye, Obinna Onwujekwe, Lumbwe Chola, Edwine Barasa

No published study has estimated the cost of hospitalised paediatric typhoid cases in Kenya.
